name: EFLeverVault flash-loan balance inflation
summary: EFLeverVault authenticated receiveFlashLoan() only by requiring Balancer as caller, so anyone could ask Balancer to invoke its withdrawal branch and release leveraged collateral as ETH. withdraw() then sent the vault's entire ETH balance to one share holder instead of that holder's proportional amount.
notes: The direct EFLeverVault runtime was deployed in this transaction and is byte-identical immediately before the incident; its linked SafeMath library predates the vault and is also byte-identical across the interval.

The reported incident total is 750 ETH across the two same-block transactions using the same vault defect, valued at $996,846.76 with the incident-time ETH price. The selected front-run transaction independently establishes 480.008083265872754211 ETH of net vault loss onchain.
